trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature transitioning from the center toward the posterior-lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on both the far-left and far-right distal tips; numerous healed circular lesions across the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique overlapping 'ghost-ring' patterns on the medial-right section where multiple circular scars intersect.
